specimens.label: Territory axis factorization

source.claim: The former four-value axis decomposes without loss into Substrate x Deploy_State.

specimens.declared_grain: one classification-schema factor for one estate-surface coordinate
specimens.reconstruction_rule: For each former Territory classification, reconstruct its meaning as the constrained Cartesian coordinate Substrate(value) AND Deploy_State(value); removal of either axis loses physical-home or deployment-state information.
specimens.notes: Axes are normalized as schema factors at one meta-grain; their member values retain their own domain grains. Grammar v1 explicitly admits products of independent axes.

specimens.label: Epistemic tag legend five-axis recast

source.claim: A flat six-tag legend failed all four postulates and was recast as five orthogonal axes.

specimens.declared_grain: one annotation-schema factor for one report claim
specimens.reconstruction_rule: Reconstruct one annotation as the product of its independently optional/applicable Authority AND Realization AND Basis AND Resolution AND Genesis coordinates; omitted inapplicable coordinates carry declared null, not a sixth meaning.
specimens.notes: The source demonstrates composability such as RATIFIED plus BUILT and names five different intents/grains; conjunction with explicit nullability expresses the orthogonal product.

specimens.label: mutation_purpose five-axis act tuple

source.claim: The adopted remedy is Epistemic_Intent x Operational_Objective x Transition_Form x Exposure_Class x Evidence_Output_Class with Gate_Profile derived from the tuple.

specimens.declared_grain: one classification-schema factor for one proposed act
specimens.reconstruction_rule: Reconstruct an act classification as the Cartesian tuple of all five axis coordinates; derive Gate_Profile as the join of per-axis constraints rather than a maintained tuple roster.
specimens.notes: Each axis changes a distinct gate contribution, so removing one changes both classification and remedy.

specimens.label: trust-base membership rule factorization

source.claim: The flattened rule is replaced by orthogonal Proof_Role and Empirical_Status axes.

specimens.declared_grain: one classification-schema factor for one proof component
specimens.reconstruction_rule: Reconstruct one component's trust-support coordinate as Proof_Role(value) AND Empirical_Status(value); proof termination and observed failure standing vary independently and jointly scope reliance.
specimens.notes: The source's counterexample permits a TRUST_BASE member with any empirical status, directly exercising independence.

specimens.label: resolution census verdict taxonomy factorization

source.claim: The starting verdict taxonomy is split into assessment state, resolution state, and zero-or-more failure mechanism labels.

specimens.declared_grain: one classification-schema factor for one surface x concept binding
specimens.reconstruction_rule: Reconstruct a finding as assessment_state AND conditionally-applicable resolution_state AND zero-or-more failure_classes; NOT_ASSESSED maps resolution_state to null and failures to empty, while ASSESSED unresolved rows admit one or more mechanisms.
specimens.notes: This is a constrained product rather than an unconstrained roster. Conjunction expresses dependency constraints in reconstruction_rule without inventing a third operator.

specimens.label: Lifecycle contest split into Class and Stage

source.claim: The contested umbrella resolves as two distinct objects: artifact-grain shape and vertical-grain position.

specimens.declared_grain: one semantic-sense partition of the formerly ambiguous lifecycle umbrella
specimens.reconstruction_rule: Partition every formerly contested lifecycle assertion by its question and subject grain: artifact life-shape assertions map to Lifecycle_Class OR vertical position-in-life assertions map to Lifecycle_Stage; the union exhausts the two attested senses and the two children remain distinct.
specimens.notes: Normalization occurs at semantic-sense partition grain, not at artifact or vertical instance grain. The children retain different governed object grains; disjunction classifies the ambiguous parent sense set without flattening those object grains back together.

conclusion: Grammar v1 retrodicts all six measured decompositions: five as conjunctive axis products (including constrained products) and the cross-grain lifecycle ambiguity as a disjunctive partition at semantic-sense meta-grain. No v2 operator is required by this battery.
